title: Yearly Trade-In Ceilings and Disposal Figures for Northbeam Renew Trade-In
content:
The devices one profile may trade in a rolling year, the most credit one profile may be issued in a rolling year, the credit paid for a device found worth nothing but still recycled, what is done with such a device, who pays to send a declined device back and the days within which it goes are all figures of the Northbeam Renew Trade-In programme the agreement is written under.

| Renew programme | Devices one profile may trade in a rolling year | Most credit one profile may be issued in a rolling year, USD | Credit for a device worth nothing but recycled, USD | What is done with a device found worth nothing | Who pays to send a declined device back | Days within which a declined device is sent back |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renew Instant Store Quote | 5 | 1500.00 | 5.00 | recycled with the recycling credit paid, or returned if the customer asks | not applicable, the device never left the customer | 0 |
| Renew Mail In Appraisal | 8 | 3000.00 | 5.00 | recycled with the recycling credit paid, or returned if the customer asks | the retailer | 5 |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | 2 | 2000.00 | 10.00 | returned to the customer unless they ask for recycling | the retailer | 5 |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | 2 | 3200.00 | 10.00 | returned to the customer unless they ask for recycling | the retailer | 5 |
| Renew Business Asset Buyback | 400 | 120000.00 | 2.00 | recycled under the contract with no credit | the business | 10 |
| Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement | 2000 | 400000.00 | 1.00 | recycled under the contract with no credit | the business | 15 |

Notes.

1. The first two columns are ceilings on one profile across a rolling year, not on one agreement.
2. The recycling credit column stands as a figure on all six programmes, but on the two business programmes a device found worth nothing is recycled under the contract with no credit paid.
3. The return columns cover a device the customer has declined: who carries it back and the days within which it goes. Renew Instant Store Quote shows 0 days and no carrier, the device never having left the customer.
